title: Twenty-six times
subtitle: Report seven, edit page
intro: Twenty-six times. It is as if he is cataloguing his own abyss. First put these seven cards back where they happened.
closing: Twenty-six times, and only once was afterglow. He calls it a spark.

cards.label: The trip to hell, unconscious
cards.line: When he woke, there were 17 missed calls on his phone.

cards.label: First od
cards.line: The first time. Rooftop. One blister of dextromethorphan.

cards.label: The Fifth Plateau
cards.line: The five senses dissolve; words become bugs.

cards.label: The afterglow memory returns
cards.line: The only time. Spring Festival, the gala, fireworks.

cards.label: Second odplus
cards.line: The second time. He wanted to see the afterglow again.

cards.label: The last time
cards.line: He has not decided whether there will be a next.

cards.label: The repeat turns out the opposite
